items.source: Returns whether the given type is managed by the backing JPA Metamodel.
items.translation: 返回给定的类型是否由底层 JPA Metamodel 管理。

items.source:
Returns whether the given type is considered a mapped type, i.e. an actually JPA persisted entity, mapped
superclass or native JPA embeddable.
items.translation: 返回给定的类型是否被视为映射类型，即实际上的 JPA 持久化实体、映射的超类或原生 JPA 嵌入对象。

items.source: Returns whether the attribute of given name and type is the single identifier attribute of the given entity.
items.translation: 返回给定名称和类型的属性是否为给定实体的单个标识符属性。

items.source: Wrapper around the JPA Metamodel to be able to apply some fixes against bugs in provider implementations.
items.translation: 对 JPA `Metamodel` 的包装器，以便能够针对提供者实现中的某些错误应用修复。

items.source: Oliver Gierke, Mark Paluch, Sylvère Richard, Aref Behboodi
